name: ScanStrip
job: A draggable auto-scrolling product strip where a beam at the centre turns each photo into its spec sheet as it passes
visitor_action: watch, drag or flick the strip, scroll the wheel to nudge it, arrow keys to step
owner_settings: Cards (photo, alt text, spec title, spec lines)
mobile: drag to scroll with momentum, vertical page scroll preserved
motion: constant drift, drag sets velocity with 0.95 friction decay, per-frame clip-path split at the beam; tapered laser beam on canvas (white core, tinted glow, flicker, points at both ends) that intensifies while a card crosses it, with a particle spray off the beam into the incoming photo side (mirrors with direction) that scales with scroll speed (paused offscreen and when paused; reduced-motion: static CSS beam, no particles or drift, spec sheet shows on hover or focus)
art_direction: Survey sheet: graphite stage, grid-ruled paper twin with ink hairlines and mono spec rows, one signal-orange beam
